method: Manual whole1576line Actions.cpp reading in five contiguous sections; pinned bytes verified. No action executed.
findings: Central UI capability table normally requires IsScanSettled unless allowEarly. File/shell capabilities and selected type masks differ. UI enabled-state rules are not universal handler-side validation; individual handlers vary.

StopScanningEngine cancels blocking worker I/O, suspends queues with UI pumping, cancels execution, joins coordinator and clears queues; resumes frozen clock. Coordinator combines strongest stop reason then joins workers.

Abort exits before postscan accounting/finalization. Stop follows same remaining finalization path as normal completion, including ScanItemsFinalize, extension data and progress completion. Thus settled/DONE after user Stop can describe partial enumeration.

StartScanningEngine resolves detached watcher paths to nearest modeled ancestor, resolves hardlink references before deleting snapshots, deduplicates selected pointers and prunes descendant refreshes. Derived duplicate/top/search views removed before source children.
Folder roots share bounded worker pool while keeping volume-specific contexts; MTP queue uses1worker, filesystem queues configured threads. Number of filesystem pools can still grow with volumes.

Empty items request launches coordinator with no enumeration queues but still recalculates hardlink/accounting/finalization/search totals. This explains loaded-model and display-only recalculation paths without implying disk rescan.

Hardlink UI update validates settled duplicate view, nonsampled selection, files and same volume. Execution rechecks settled/view/nonsampled, chooses separate source per stored hash group and calls CreateHardlinkFromFile; no content recompare in this handler. Helper implementation remains unreviewed as whole source.

Empty-directory cleanup excludes modeled reparse/invalid ancestors, deduplicates traversal, reverses directory order, then rechecks current path attributes before RemoveDirectory. This is a useful recheck but not an atomic handle-based resolution guarantee.
Quiet-save branches return process status from writer result after finalization; this indicates export success, not an independently complete scan/corpus quality oracle.
Shell move, compression, dates, cleanup utilities and profile removal read only. Operation progress or a later refresh does not by itself prove each filesystem action succeeded.
limits: No Windows concurrency, I/O cancellation, file replacement, export or destructive action executed.
Previous partial Actions.cpp excerpts now receive one whole-file credit; prior controls not rerun or added to counts.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
